A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GEDI research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices support a reliable comparison; shifted material and the revised diagram can be matched.

before.justification: V4 reports original clustering, generation, OOD detection and MNIST addition experiments in Section 6, with additional empirical results and analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: V5 retains these original experiments, including the main benchmark results, appendix linear-probe and OOD evaluations, and MNIST analyses.

M1.justification: The GEDI objective, shared discriminative/energy model, SGLD and Adam training in Algorithm 1, and neuro-symbolic loss substitution remain unchanged. Figure 7 clarifies the existing procedure without introducing a component.

E1.justification: Both versions use moons, circles, SVHN, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and MNIST addition. Clustering, generation, OOD detection, linear-probe evaluation and symbol-grounding coverage are retained, including appendix evaluations.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain JEM, Barlow Twins, SwAV, the same GEDI ablations and the same neuro-symbolic comparison conditions. The added references do not introduce evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendices L–O retain the training budgets, architectures, augmentations and evaluation procedures. Metrics and the MNIST protocol using 100, 1,000 and 10,000 addition examples are unchanged.

E4.justification: The loss-component ablations and training-loss analyses in Figures 3–4, loss-weight sensitivity analysis in Figure 8, and neuro-symbolic versus invariance-loss analysis in Figure 11 are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: The same five-run or initialization-seed reporting and means with standard deviations remain in Tables 2–4 and 10. Table 6 retains median and standard-deviation reporting, and Figure 8 retains five-seed averaging.

E6.justification: Tables 2–6 and 10–12 retain their entries and values. For example, Table 4 GEDI NMI remains 0.25/0.44/0.87 and FID remains 193/214/226 for SVHN/CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100. The qualitative experimental results also match.

T1.justification: The probabilistic definitions, SSL derivations, GEDI lower bound, failure-mode theorem and proofs in Sections 2–4 and Appendices B–K are unchanged. Figure 7's revised output notation does not introduce a different mathematical definition.

C1.justification: The introduction changes the broad performance comparison from state-of-the-art cluster-based SSL solutions to standard cluster-based SSL methods, locally narrowing that claim. The following paragraph still claims state-of-the-art clustering improvements, and the central unification and failure-mode contributions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: V5's introduction newly argues that architectural heuristics used to prevent collapse often hamper generative capabilities. V4 already discussed avoiding asymmetries but did not explicitly make this connection. Experimental interpretations and limitations in Section 7 and Appendix N remain unchanged.

D1.justification: V5 adds a direct repository link and states in the abstract that the code is publicly available; v4 only promised release upon acceptance. V5 retains that older promise in Section 6. Appendix implementation settings are unchanged, while Section 8 newly identifies the computing-resource providers.

R1.justification: V5 adds Barsalou (1999) to the symbol-grounding discussion and Tong et al. (2024) to the bibliography. It also cites the already-listed Sansone (2023) in the introduction. The substantive related-work discussion otherwise remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The introduction is reorganized around formulation, integration and unification, removing a duplicated sentence and separating the discussion into clearer paragraphs. V5 adds Section 8 on contributions and acknowledgements and makes limited copyediting changes; most technical prose and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 7 replaces the unlabeled colored constraint block with an explicit Symbolic Program box and a separate output label, retaining the neural branches. Existing tables and figures shift with pagination, while their other displays and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: V5 removes duplicated introductory prose, clarifies the motivation and Figure 7's neural/symbolic distinction, and adds a concrete code-access reference and contribution disclosures. These are limited clarity and transparency improvements; the theoretical and empirical support is unchanged. The conflicting code-release statements in the abstract and Section 6 remain a documentation weakness.
